## What changed?

Describe the product or engineering problem and the change that solves it.

## Evidence

What proves the change works? Include tests, screenshots or logs where useful.

## Verification

- [ ] Product spec updated when observable behavior changed
- [ ] Backend lint/tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint/build pass
- [ ] OpenAPI contract updated when endpoints changed
- [ ] Docker smoke test run when infrastructure changed
- [ ] Deterministic calculations remain outside the LLM
- [ ] No credentials or local environment files committed
